name: Source Control
description: Unified interface for interacting with version control and remote Git repositories. Actions: list_repositories, read_file, create_branch, inspect_diff, run_checks, request_approval, push_branch, create_change_request. All remote write operations strictly require explicit human approval via approval tickets.

action.description: The source-control action to execute. Aliases accepted: 'list_repos', 'read', 'branch', 'diff', 'checks', 'approve', 'push', 'pr', 'create_pr'.

params.description: Optional structured parameter bag for the action. Any of the parameters below may also be passed directly as top-level fields.

repository_id.description: Stable provider repository identifier (required for list/read actions and as the target of pushes and change requests).

provider.description: Provider to use. Defaults to the only connected provider.

account_id.description: Optional stable account ID when multiple accounts are connected for the same provider.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to read from (optional for 'read_file'; defaults to default branch).

from_sha.description: Optional starting commit SHA for 'create_branch'; defaults to HEAD.

base_sha.description: Base commit SHA to diff against (optional for 'inspect_diff').

include_patch.description: Include per-file unified diff text in 'inspect_diff' output (default: true).

checks.description: Names of pre-registered checks to run (required for 'run_checks').

fail_fast.description: Stop after the first failing check (default: true).

local_branch.description: Local branch to push (optional for 'push_branch'; defaults to operation's source branch).

draft.description: Create as draft change request (optional for 'create_change_request'; default: true).
